title: Signal: Private key block header in source
limitations: Matches PEM-style private-key headers (RSA/EC/OPENSSH/generic) only. Certificates, public keys, single-line non-PEM keys, and encrypted keystores do not match. The header carries no key material; evidence is the header alone.
